ExampleDefinition.ToolTipDescription: Demonstrates vector field charts using both uniform and scattered (non-uniform) data, with VectorFieldRenderableSeries, configurable color mode, length mode, arrowhead style and more.
ExampleDefinition.Description:
Demonstrates a [b]Vector Field Chart[/b] using [b]VectorFieldRenderableSeries[/b] with two dataset types, each backed by a different data series class.
[b]Sinusoidal Vortices (Uniform)[/b] uses [b]UniformVectorFieldDataSeries[/b] - vectors are placed on a regular grid. The field is derived from a sinusoidal stream function, producing an alternating vortex pattern with smoothly varying magnitudes.
[b]Dual Vortex Flow (Non-Uniform)[/b] uses [b]NonUniformVectorFieldDataSeries[/b] - vectors are placed at randomly scattered positions across the domain, skipping excluded regions around two point vortices of different sizes located in opposite corners. The superimposed co-rotating vortices produce a swirling flow pattern.
[b]Features demonstrated[/b]
- [b]UniformVectorFieldDataSeries[/b] for regular-grid vector data - [b]NonUniformVectorFieldDataSeries[/b] for arbitrarily positioned (scattered) vector data - ColorMode: Solid, ByMagnitude, ByDirection - color sampled from HeatmapColorPalette - LengthMode: DataUnits, MagnitudePixels, FixedPixels - with MagnitudeScale and PixelLength slider - ArrowHeadLength, ArrowHeadWidth and IsArrowHeadFilled controls - Grid density slider (uniform mode) and vector count slider (non-uniform mode) - Interactive control of vector field visual density using the CullingCellSize slider - Per-vector inspection using TooltipModifier, displaying the vector origin and magnitude on hover - Vector selection with DataPointSelectionModifier, with visual highlighting implemented via a PaletteProvider
